newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 9.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 9. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Indonesia's Information Minister has said the general election campaign which will last through May 23 has not had any impact on the country's stock market. The election will be held on May 29.

Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana has confirmed that Newmont Mining Corp of the United States refused to give a 10-percent share of a gold mine operated by its subsidiary to the Indonesian government. The government said earlier this month it had asked for a 10-percent share in the Batu Hijau gold mine in West Nusa Tenggara. The mine is controlled by PT Newmont Nusa Tenggara, a subsidiary of Newmont Mining Corp.

Armed Forces Commander General Feisal Tanjung has said there was no problem with the "coalition" between supporters of the Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP) and those of the Christian-Nationalist Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) loyal to its ousted leader Megawati Sukarnoputri.
